checklist.title: Poseidon Hash Circuit Edge Integrity

detection_procedure.description: Verify that edges in GRAPH-POSEIDON-HASH-CIRCUIT correctly propagate hash state through all permutation rounds without corruption.
steps: Trace EDGE-POSEIDON-START to confirm proper initialization of hash state
Verify EDGE-POSEIDON-CONFIG-LOADED passes correct round constants and MDS matrix
Check EDGE-POSEIDON-ABSORBED correctly incorporates input elements into state
Validate EDGE-POSEIDON-CONSTANTS-ADDED, EDGE-POSEIDON-SBOX-APPLIED, EDGE-POSEIDON-MDS-APPLIED maintain round integrity
Confirm EDGE-POSEIDON-NEXT-ROUND correctly iterates without skipping rounds
Verify EDGE-POSEIDON-OUTPUT produces canonical hash output

executable_checks.description: Run Poseidon test vectors to validate hash computation through all edges
Locate Poseidon implementation for manual edge flow review

checklist.notes: Poseidon is fundamental to ZK proof system. Edge corruption could break proof soundness. Sub-graph edge coverage - focus on EDGE-POSEIDON-START as primary element.
